deduplication_rule: earliest first captured price/time, then smallest original forward_key; never grade-based, never best hindsight sportsbook price
estimated_ci_method: group resampling by independent ESPN event/game for both unique-line and one-per-game alternative, 2000 nonparam resamples 95% two-sided, seed 20261009
official_identity_rule: unique finished official ESPN season2027 PRESEASON game with exact UTC start <=3m, exact home and away team abbreviation alias and noncontradictory final points; every quote selected side graded from independently final total+original quoted line
one_quote_per_official_game_rule: earliest original frozen game-market TOTAL quote by capture timestamp, then smallest immutable forward_key
source_pre_game_rule: original quote captured before ESPN official first pitch and original source game event kickoff
source_price_metric: original price American implied unit net win odds/100 or 100/abs(odds), loss -1, push 0; NOT independently executable
source_probability_comparator: original source entry_v2_probability_pct versus entry_market_reference_probability_pct on exact same frozen side and actual independently verified NBA final, Brier
unique_immutable_market_identity: NBA, exact official game_key, TOTAL, OVER/UNDER, exact source line; ignores retrospective legacy regime-key duplication
